meta.write: stretching budget as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. The cubic's payers are a number. Time did not empty them. A share is not a bound.

lemmas.name: B26_payers_readable
lemmas.statement: stretching budget, CF weight, and aligned majority are readable together
lemmas.why: Weighted |cos α_3| sits above the unweighted mean. A majority of (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c comes from the aligned cap. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B26a_share_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: an aligned (ω·Sω)_+ share closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: A 65% share is a number. X is still the L² enstrophy. A payer count is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B26b_emptying_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: time emptying the aligned cap is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: B15c and B15d already missed. Median stays near 1/2. frac_hi stays ~0.65. Tesla: time was a knob. It did not empty the cap.

lemmas.name: B26c_share_not_a_class
lemmas.statement: a ~65% aligned share of (ω·Sω)_+ is a geometric class that bounds X
lemmas.why: A share on 3-shell CONC packets is not all data. Majda: do not promote a payer count to a type.

lemmas.name: B26d_aligned_budget_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: an aligned stretching budget is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A 65% share of (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not glue a payer count to Biot–Savart.

lemmas.name: B26e_enstrophy_leftover
lemmas.why: Scored as B16e / B27. A cancelled net is not continuation. Coherent blob is not an a priori (B17e). Field occupation is not an a priori (B18e). Field glue is not an a priori (B19e). NS climb is not an a priori (B20e). Climb sketch is not an a priori (B21e). Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). Finer DNS is not an a priori (B23e). Leftover close is not an a priori (B34e). Regularity stays open. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B26f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring the stretching budget as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The share is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss. No Q1. No ε.
